login.title: Log in
login.name: Full name
properties.name: Name
dashboard.no_properties: No properties yet. Add your first one to get started.
documents.title: Title
install.prompt: Install HomeVault on this device for quick access.
install.ios_hint: Install HomeVault: tap Share, then "Add to Home Screen".
qr.install_link: 📱 Scan to open on your phone
equipment.name: Name
equipment.find_online_hint: Opens a search in a new tab — no data is sent automatically. Attach what you find as a document.
qr.thermal_hint: Select your label/thermal printer in the print dialog. For an exact fit, its paper size should match the one chosen here.
error.network: Could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
documents.delete_confirm: Delete “{{title}}”? The file will be removed permanently.
equipment.delete_confirm: Delete “{{name}}”? Its photos and maintenance history will be removed too.
equipment.documents_hint: Link a document to this equipment from the document's edit screen.
settings.language_hint: Also used for the language of reminder emails.
settings.viewer_note: You have view-only access to this property.
settings.delete_property_hint: Permanently deletes this property with all its documents, equipment, reminders and expenses.
settings.delete_property_confirm: Delete “{{name}}” and everything in it? This cannot be undone.
settings.members_hint: Owners can edit. Viewers can look things up and tick off reminders.
settings.role_hint: The person needs an account first. An admin can create one below.
settings.accounts_hint: Create logins for family members, then share properties with them. They choose their own password at first sign-in.
settings.password_hint: At least 10 characters. A few random words make a strong, memorable password.
login.invalid_credentials: That email and password don't match.
login.rate_limited: Too many failed attempts. Try again in about {{count}} min.
login.mfa_hint: Open your authenticator app and enter the current code for HomeVault.
login.mfa_invalid: That code isn't right. Check that your phone's clock is correct and try again.
login.mfa_expired: That sign-in timed out. Please enter your password again.
login.recovery_hint: Each recovery code works once. Use one if you can't reach your authenticator app.
login.setup_token_hint: Printed by the deploy script, or set as SETUP_TOKEN in your .env file.
login.setup_token_wrong: The setup token is missing or incorrect.
force.title: Choose a new password
force.intro: Hi {{name}}, you're signing in with a temporary password. Pick your own to continue.
settings.password_signs_out: Changing it signs you out of your other devices.
twofactor.title: Two-factor authentication
twofactor.summary: Adds a 6-digit code from your phone to every sign-in, so a stolen password alone isn't enough.
twofactor.intro: You'll need an authenticator app such as Google Authenticator, Authy, 1Password, Bitwarden or Aegis. First, confirm your password.
twofactor.scan: Scan this QR code with your authenticator app.
twofactor.qr_label: QR code for your authenticator app
twofactor.enter_code: Then enter the 6-digit code it shows
twofactor.code_invalid: That code isn't valid. Check your phone's clock and try again.
twofactor.recovery_intro: Save these recovery codes somewhere safe, like a password manager. Each works once if you lose your phone. They won't be shown again.
sessions.title: Signed-in devices
sessions.summary: Browsers and phones currently signed in to your account. Sign out any you don't recognise.
sessions.revoke_others_confirm: Sign out of every other browser and phone? You'll stay signed in here.
activity.title: Recent security activity
activity.summary: Sign-ins and security changes on your account. Anything that wasn't you? Change your password.
feeds.title: Calendar links
feeds.summary: Subscribe Apple Calendar, Google Calendar or Outlook to HomeVault. Reminders, tasks, expiring documents and warranty ends appear alongside your other events, with alerts.
feeds.label: Name
feeds.once_warning: Copy it now: for your security it won't be shown again. Anyone with this link can see these dates, so don't share it.
feeds.http_warning: This site isn't using HTTPS, so the link travels unencrypted. Prefer to subscribe over HTTPS.
feeds.revoke_confirm: Revoke “{{label}}”? Calendars subscribed with it will stop updating.
feeds.privacy: Each link is a secret: revoke it here if it leaks. Calendar apps refresh every few hours.
admin.make_admin_checkbox: Administrator (can manage accounts and sees every property)
admin.reset_password_confirm: Reset {{name}}'s password? They'll be signed out everywhere and must choose a new one.
admin.reset_password_intro: Give {{name}} this temporary password. They'll be asked to replace it at their next sign-in.
admin.reset_2fa_confirm: Turn off two-factor authentication for {{name}}? Only do this after you've confirmed it's really them.
admin.delete_confirm: Delete {{name}}'s account? This only works for accounts with no records; otherwise disable it instead.
admin.account_created_intro: Give {{email}} this temporary password. They'll choose their own at first sign-in.
admin.temp_hint: Share the temporary password in person or through a secure channel.
audit_log.title: Audit log
audit_log.summary: Who did what, when and from where. Kept for about 13 months.
backup.title: Database backup
backup.summary: Download a consistent copy of the database (accounts and records). Uploaded files are not included; they live in your data folder. Automatic daily backups are also kept on the server.
backup.sensitive: This file contains password hashes. Store it somewhere private.
search.title: Search
search.hint: Type at least 2 characters. Use ↑ ↓ and Enter.
equipment.no_reminders: No maintenance scheduled for this item yet.
equipment.suggested: Suggested schedule: one click adds a recurring reminder.
audit.mfa_enroll_failed: Wrong code while setting up two-factor
audit.reauth_failed: Wrong password when confirming a change
audit.sessions_revoked_all: Signed out of all other devices
update.title: Software update
update.summary: HomeVault checks GitHub for new releases. Nothing about you or your data is sent.
update.dev_hint: This copy runs from source, so it doesn't offer updates. Pull the latest code instead.
update.install_note: Takes a minute or two. HomeVault makes a backup first and goes back to the old version by itself if the new one doesn't start.
update.no_updater: One-click updates need the updater, which isn't running on this server. To update now, run this on the server (it makes a backup first):
update.waiting_for_updater: Waiting for the updater to start…
update.reconnecting: HomeVault is restarting… this page reconnects by itself.
update.keep_open: HomeVault restarts briefly during the update. Keep this page open.
update.rolled_back: The update to v{{version}} didn't start correctly, so HomeVault went back to the previous version. Your data is untouched.
update.confirm_intro: HomeVault will back up its data, install v{{version}} and restart. Confirm with your password to continue.
